manifest.name: dsh-wsl-windows-folder-picker
manifest.description: Windows folder picker for dsh on WSL
manifest.author: VoidPrim (https://github.com/VoidPrim)

bundle.text:
# dsh-wsl-windows-folder-picker — profile patch.
#
# The shipped adaptive chooser (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`)
# resolves its backend once at boot, and its Linux branch drives only
# zenity/kdialog — there is no Windows branch at all. On WSL, with neither
# chooser binary installed, it therefore always resolves `browse`, so a Windows
# folder dialog is unreachable through it.
#
# This patch does NOT disable that chooser. It stays exactly as shipped, and this
# package's Host half refines what it serves instead — see `lib/index.js`, which
# shadows the seam's `capability()` for as long as it is mounted.
#
# Leaving the chooser in place is deliberate, and it is what makes disabling this
# plugin harmless. The chooser keeps serving its own interaction and keeps the
# browser surface that renders the in-page add-workspace flow mounted, so
# switching this plugin off returns to the stock picker instead of leaving the
# two directory-flow slots empty. Those are `single` slots with no default
# occupant: whoever owns them owns the whole add-workspace affordance, so the
# fallback must never depend on this package being mounted.
#
# Off WSL the expression below is false and this package's row is not mounted —
# so installing this can never change the picker on a native Linux, macOS, or
# Windows host.

- insert:
    # The Host half: refines `ctx.directoryPicker` into one dispatching
    # capability — the Windows folder dialog, or the stock interaction when
    # interop cannot run it. Disabled off WSL so the shipped chooser is left
    # untouched elsewhere.
    #
    # Three WSL markers are tested because no single one is always exported: a
    # dsh launched from a service or a minimal environment may carry only some
    # of them. Any WSL marker under a Linux platform is conclusive, since plain
    # Linux does not set them.
    - id: wsl-windows-folder-picker
      name: 'dsh-wsl-windows-folder-picker'
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'linux' || !(process.env.WSL_DISTRO_NAME || process.env.WSL_INTEROP || process.env.WSLENV)

readme.text:
**English** | [中文](README_cn.md)

Use the Windows folder dialog when using dsh under WSL.

Requires dsh `>=0.1.7-rc.1`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:VoidPrim/dsh-wsl-windows-folder-picker
```

Restart dsh after installing, then refresh the page:

```bash
dsh web
```

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-wsl-windows-folder-picker
```
